profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at iManage
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the industry. Skilled in Web Development, Application Programming Interfaces, Management, and Full Stack Development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with project managers and stakeholders to define project scopes effectively.
- Engaged in an agile work setting, actively contributing to the ideation and execution of platform features.
- Applied industry standard SDLC methodologies, emphasizing continuous integration, automated unit testing, regression testing, and ensuring comprehensive end-to-end delivery quality.
- Applied expertise in React, Jenkins, Spring, Python, and leveraged Continuous Integration and Delivery
methodologies within the AWS environment.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), JavaScript and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- CSTEPS: Collaboration Tool for Engineering Students at UIUC
- Designed a software for students to work together in groups and complete discussion activities.
- Integrated machine learning models on the data acquired from the software to predict and notify teachers if a group needed help.
- Leveraged Knowledge in Full Stack Development, Node.js, Python, React.js, MongoDB and user testing.

company.name: Colearn Lab - University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Visual Search: Navigate Grainger’s catalog with a picture of the product
- Enhanced the user experience by integrating depth detection into Visual Search, optimizing search results for users.
- Orchestrated the design of multi-camera functionality on iPhone devices, enabling precise object proximity detection and guiding users to capture high-quality images.
- Significantly improved search result accuracy by over 50% through innovative methods, including product-to-camera distance detection and automatic flash activation in low-light settings.
- Applied expertise in Git version control, Swift programming, Xcode debugging, multi-device development (iPhone & iPad), and utilized Memory Analyzer for efficient software development and optimization.
positions.insights: Swift (Programming Language), Version Control and +1 skill

positions.title: Frontend Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- iManage Work: Legal Document Management System
- Streamlined User Interface using Angular and brought consistency in design throughout the website.
- Collaborated with UI-UX Team to develop innovative designs to enhance the user experience.
- Developed extensions for customers to build on the existing software using API calls.
- Standardized a system to automate the testing of extensions using Python and Selenium.
- Leveraged Knowledge in Frontend Development, React, Automation using Python and Selenium.
